acceptanceResults: Cleanup-pending and receipt-missing re-observation projections include the exact repository-bound Work Item finalize-verify command and never omit its binding arguments.
The projection remains observe-only, does not recommend deletion, and uses the same action model consumed by human-facing rendering.
A regression test fails before the fix and passes after it for the exact argv, including --repo and --id.

A pull-request quality route for a Work Item without provider resourceContext resolves the unique active Contract encoded by the dedicated branch, without weakening exact resource-bound PR selection or release/recovery identity checks.

An absent or ambiguous branch-to-Work-Item mapping fails with one structured diagnostic before compilation or expensive quality jobs, and existing explicit release/recovery failures remain fail-closed.
Regression coverage proves ordinary no-resource PR selection, exact resource-bound PR precedence, and ambiguous/unmatched branch rejection.
A pull-request branch fallback accepts only an active Contract with no resourceContext; provisional or otherwise resource-bound Contracts never qualify by branch alone.
When a no-resource branch candidate shares its branch with any resource-bound Contract whose PR identity is not an exact match, resolution fails closed with a structured branch-conflict diagnostic.
Regression coverage proves provisional-resource rejection, resource-bound same-branch conflict rejection, and that push/tag routes never use the pull-request branch fallback.
An ordinary push with no merged pull request emits its ordinary repository route without an unbound-array failure.
An empty active Contract inventory produces the resolver's structured unresolved diagnostic instead of a shell unbound-array failure.
